irrigated-plain.note: Deep clay-loam of the Tadla and Haouz plains: holds water well, often alkaline and chalky.

rainfed-plateau.note: Shallow to medium plateau soil on the Saïss and Chaouia: workable, but low in phosphorus.

oasis.note: Sandy, chalky oasis soil with a salinity risk when irrigation water is pumped from a falling water table.
